rows.note: This is the all-purpose chemical name for ammonia itself.

example.english: The ammonia in the lab has a very pungent smell.
example.traditional: 實驗室入面嘅氨有陣好刺鼻嘅味。
example.jyutping: sat6 jim6 sat1 jap6 min6 ge3 on1 jau5 zan6 hou2 ci3 bei6 ge3 mei6

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing ammonia as a gas, such as in a leak or an industrial setting.

example.english: Ammonia gas leaked at the factory, so everyone immediately put on masks and went outside.
example.traditional: 工場漏咗氨氣，大家即刻戴口罩走出去。
example.jyutping: gung1 coeng4 lau6 zo2 on1 hei3 daai6 gaa1 zik1 hak1 daai3 hau2 zaau3 zau2 ceot1 heoi3

rows.note: Use this specifically for ammonia dissolved in water, especially household cleaning solution.

example.english: When I was cleaning the windows, I added a little ammonia solution to the bucket of water.
example.traditional: 抹窗嗰陣，我加咗少少氨水落桶水度。
example.jyutping: mut3 coeng1 go2 zan6 ngo5 gaa1 zo2 siu2 siu2 on1 seoi2 lok6 tung2 seoi2 dou6
